name: Agent Kernel
summary: The installed agent context, templates, prompt rules, and response conventions that let a Codex enter Farplane with the right operating shape.

name: Work Loop
summary: The durable loop that turns intent into plans, tickets, skills, implementation, and reviewable proof for one bounded unit of work.

name: Horizon Loop
summary: The project control loop where metric movement flows through report-first Interval review into the ticket board, with Work Pulse dispatch and Plan Next Wave as low-supply refill.

name: Retired Invocation Runtime
summary: Historical record for the removed invocation envelope, board, compute, and ticket-runtime experiment.

name: Proof And Review
summary: The QA, review, completion, and adversarial testing surfaces that keep Farplane work evidence-backed instead of self-certified.

name: Skill System
summary: The reusable expertise layer: skill tiers, packaging, templates, evals, QA checklists, registry intelligence, and maintenance constraints.

name: Self-Improvement And Learning
summary: Goal-backed improvement loops that seed a campaign-local hypothesis tree from bounded sources, then use one active-Goal choose-next decision with conditional Leverage comparison and refine from evidence.

name: Source And Sidecar Systems
summary: The external-source, video-to-skill, and sidecar-product surfaces that let Farplane adapt useful patterns without making them live dependencies.

name: Maintenance And Release OS
summary: The release hygiene, adoption scans, manifests, rollout checks, and maintenance validators that keep Farplane coherent as it evolves.

name: Domain Skill Families
summary: The specialized skill families for frontend, media, content, and future vertical workflows that build on the core Work Loop and Skill System.

name: Documentation OS
summary: The documentation architecture, feature/system specs, registries, doc lifecycle, and doc-advisor surfaces that keep Farplane's durable written truth human-readable and machine-indexable.

name: Content Production
summary: The reusable content workflow that composes an idea with approved Brand Kit identity and optional computed Tasty Pack inspiration into a reviewable production program and proof trail.

name: Graph Systems
summary: The two graph planes that turn canonical entity knowledge or repository declarations into World, CRM, typed-domain, skill, backlink, framework, and lifecycle projections.
